title: oligocodon cunliffeae
intro: Oligocodon cunliffeae, commonly known as Cunliffe's snake-root or snake-root, is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Oligocodon cunliffeae include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and treating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
